title: Understanding Gen Alpha’s Digital Language: Evaluation of LLM Safety Systems for Content Moderation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the comprehension gap between Generation Alpha youth and adults/LLMs by testing interpretation accuracy of 100 Gen Alpha expressions across basic meaning, context, and safety dimensions.

Assessing LLMs' and human moderators' ability to accurately interpret rapidly evolving, platform-specific youth slang, tracking failure patterns like false positives on benign slang and missed masked harassment.

Measuring disparities in AI system interpretation by calculating false positive rates and misclassification rates for expression variants common among minority youth communities and language targeting marginalized groups.
